name: Microraptor-class target drone
description: Microraptor-class target drones, more commonly called X-wing drones, were training drones used by the TIE pilots of the First Order for live-fire training exercises, designed to imitate Resistance T-70 X-wing starfighters. Sometime after the evacuation of D'Qar, Lieutenant Galek deployed her cadets against a flight of drones, in which all of the target X-wing starfighters were destroyed.
